findings.body:
The gate label rename to `AIReview` updates this workflow's comments to cite `docs/TRIGGER_MODES.md` § "Recipe: run once when labelled `AIReview`…", but that section still exists only as "…labelled `ready`…" and still names this file as the reference implementation. `AGENTS.md` also still says self-review is "label-gated on `ready`".

Failure mode: maintainers (and this PR's own test plan) apply `ready`, the scope job emits `no-gate-label`, every leg stays Skipped, and dogfood never runs. Commit `65e3a2e` claims docs were updated, but only this YAML changed.

Either keep `ready` here to match the published recipe, or update `docs/TRIGGER_MODES.md`, `AGENTS.md`, and the README self-review pointers in the same PR so the trigger name is consistent end-to-end.

This comment classifies `codex` as a chat-completions leg that performs the complexity assessment. In runtime it is `CodexProvider(AgentRunnerProvider)` (`scripts/reviewer.py`), and `docs/PR_METADATA_CHECKS.md` § "Provider support matrix" marks `complexity-labels-enabled` as a no-op for `cursor` / `claude-code` / `codex`.

Failure mode: dogfood verification looks for a `complexity:*` label from the codex leg and never sees one; only `provider: anthropic` will call `set_pr_complexity` today.

```suggestion
          # (anthropic) perform the assessment; agent-runner legs
          # (claude-code, cursor, codex) log a no-op warning by design.
```

summary:
## Verdict

Solid complexity-label dogfood enablement, but the bundled `ready` → `AIReview` rename is incomplete and one comment misstates which providers apply complexity labels. Address both before merge.

## Findings

| # | Severity | File | Summary |
|---|----------|------|---------|
| 1 | ⚠️ warning | `.github/workflows/self-review.yml:57` | Gate label rename drifts from docs; workflow points at a non-existent TRIGGER_MODES section |
| 2 | ⚠️ warning | `.github/workflows/self-review.yml:330` | Comment claims `codex` applies complexity labels; it is agent-runner and no-ops |

## Details outside inline comments

- **PR body / test plan still say `ready`.** The second commit switches the trigger to `AIReview`, so the published test plan ("apply the `ready` label") will not fire this workflow. Update the PR description and any maintainer runbooks in the same change.
- **Commit `65e3a2e` claims "and docs"** but the diff only touches `self-review.yml`. `AGENTS.md` still says the dogfood is "label-gated on `ready`"; `docs/TRIGGER_MODES.md` § "Recipe: run once when labelled `ready`…" still cites this file as the reference implementation; `README.md` does the same.
- **Complexity enablement itself looks correct:** `pull-requests: write` is already granted; inputs match `action.yml` / `docs/PR_METADATA_CHECKS.md`; only the anthropic chat-completions leg will call `set_pr_complexity` (expected). Agent-runner legs will log the designed no-op warning.
- No security regressions spotted (no `pull_request_target`, no unpinned third-party actions, no new secret-echo paths).

## Release decision

**Recommendation:** request-changes
